content.text: Here's my plan for shipping the new Surface as a patch on the 1.7 line: I'll fold the C4 tests into v1.7.37, tag it, and we can follow up with TL blockers as another patch. I'll start by auditing the existing session token handling in the auth package, then refactor the token validation logic into a dedicated validator module so it can be unit tested in isolation. Next I'll update the login and refresh handlers to call the new validator, add structured logging around token expiry and rotation events, and write integration tests that cover the happy path plus three failure modes: expired token, malformed token, and revoked token.

You're right about the bump. I'll treat the remaining holes as a follow-up patch on 1.7.38 after we land the surface. I'll keep going through the remaining files, update the changelog, and we can retag later if you still want a minor. Let me also walk the apply path and add the tests we discussed so the suite stays green on this increment.
